title: Decision record, version 1
description: One judgment about a candidate: the question, the supplied evidence and its checksum, the judge, the response, the policy, and the recommended action. A model judgment is not a measurement, an uncertainty, or a probability of discovery. A decision does not set the status of the candidate. An assessment with basis model_judgment can cite it. The writer, the time, and the values that blinding withheld from the writer come from the request.

assessment_id.description: Optional. An assessment of the same candidate that the judgment used.

question.description: The versioned question that the judge answered, for example triage version 1.

mode.description: advisory: the decision records a recommendation and schedules nothing. Automatic modes need R6 evaluation and are not part of version 1.

judge.description: model: a language model or another trained model made the judgment. A research agent always writes model judgments. person: a person made the judgment.

model.description: The model that made the judgment, or the reason that it is unknown.

packet.description: The SHA-256 of the evidence packet that the judge received, or the reason that it is unknown.

policy.description: The versioned decision policy, or the reason that none applies.

judged_evidence_status.description: The evidence status that the judge gives. It is part of the judgment. It is not the status of the candidate.

action.description: The recommended next action. Advisory mode schedules nothing.

evidence.description: The evidence that the judge received.

response.description: Optional. The provider response, as received.

scores.description: Optional. Numbers that the judge returned. They are model judgments, not measurement uncertainties or probabilities of discovery.

supersedes.description: An earlier decision about the same candidate that this decision corrects.
